key_highlights: ASX slides to three-month low as banks and miners fall; oil jumps on Fed rate hike to 4% (#72, #17)
AUD crushed as Fed fails 'Warshach test'; RBA now more likely to raise rates (#7, #23)
IMF downgrades Australian GDP forecast amid rate-hike fears (#11)
Anthropic signs $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland — major tech infrastructure catalyst (#42)
Mining positives: record gold grades at Aguia Colombia; Auric fast-tracks WA Burbanks; Barkly rare earths in NT (#41, #43, #45)
Chinese growth 'sinks from sight' — headwind for iron ore, coal, LNG exporters (#53)
Cue and Veronika Maine up for sale after 58 years; consumer sector under stress (#73, #74)
Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports; diesel prices spike (#29, #54)
Bathla collapse triggers insolvency storm; private credit concerns mount (#33, #30)
ACCC moves to break real estate monopoly — potential REIT sector disruption (#4)

sectors.trend: Mixed: gold and rare earths positive (Aguia record grades, Barkly NT discovery, Auric WA Burbanks), but Chinese growth slowdown pressures iron ore and coal. Oil jump supports energy miners. New mining objection laws and Landcare battles add regulatory overhang.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from weak China demand. Gold miners (NEM.AX, GOLD.AX) and rare earths (LRE.AX, AUR.AX) benefit. Regulatory risk on new projects (Berkley, Fortescue) elevated.

sectors.trend: Banks fall as RBA rate-hike probability rises post-Fed 4% move. Private credit concerns (Bathla insolvency, 'cockroaches' narrative) raise systemic risk. Qantas cronyism adds political overhang. Credit growth outpacing China's debt signals froth.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from rate uncertainty and credit quality concerns. NAB.AX most exposed to Qantas-linked risk. Private credit exposure a watch item.

sectors.trend: Oil jumps again; diesel prices spike; east-coast fuel supply crunch at ports. Green hydrogen policy criticised as wasteful. Energy sector benefits from commodity strength but faces distribution bottlenecks.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil/diesel strength. Supply logistics risk for downstream. Green hydrogen policy uncertainty weighs on renewable energy names.

sectors.trend: Cue and Veronika Maine collapse after 58 years; real wages growth crushed by exploitation; casualisation narrative. Consumer spending under pressure. Costco partner bankruptcy may benefit rivals.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail arms), and consumer discretionary names face margin pressure. Superannuation reform debate (#34, #57) could shift household savings flows.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn datacentre in western QLD is a landmark Australian tech investment. AI theme strong globally but Fed-driven risk-off spooks tech. News Corp AI adoption signals sector shift.
sectors.implications: Local datacentre/infrastructure beneficiaries (VIX.AX, STOL.AX, WCN.AX) gain. ASX-listed tech remains thin; indirect beneficiaries via construction and power demand.

sectors.trend: ACCC targeting real estate monopoly; Trump policies threaten to crash Aussie house prices; Housing Trust mould issues signal tenant stress. Rate hike risk pressures valuations.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face dual pressure from rate hikes and regulatory intervention. Residential property risk elevated.

key_themes: Fed 4% rate hike spooks global risk assets; RBA follows suit — AUD crushed
IMF downgrade signals deteriorating Australian growth outlook
China growth slowdown is the dominant commodity headwind
Mining sector bifurcates: gold/rare earths strong, iron ore/coal weak
Consumer sector in structural stress: brand collapses, wage stagnation
Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre a long-term structural positive for Australian tech/infrastructure
Private credit and insolvency contagion (Bathla) raising systemic risk
Fuel supply crunch and diesel spike create inflationary pressure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike following Fed to 4%
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities; favour dividend-paying value in banks and miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Chinese growth slowdown hitting commodity exporters
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight iron ore/coal exposure (BHP.AX, FMG.AX, BRL.AX); rotate into gold and rare earths
Review bank balance-sheet exposure to private credit; favour large-cap diversified banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel supply crunch and diesel price spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor transport and logistics cost inflation; favour energy producers over consumers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Trump policy risk to Australian housing and trade
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge residential property exposure; monitor AUD/USD for trade-flow disruption

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer sector structural weakness (brand collapses, wage stagnation)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive consumer staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) over discretionary; monitor retail sales data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and rare earths miners amid China weakness and safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: Record gold grades (Aguia), Barkly rare earth discovery, and AUD weakness support gold pricing; rare earths benefit from supply-chain diversification away from China

opportunities.recommendation: Position for Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre build-out — infrastructure and power beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: Landmark $31bn investment drives construction, electrical, and datacentre REIT demand in Australia

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure on oil/diesel strength
opportunities.rationale: Oil jump and diesel spike support upstream producers; supply crunch adds pricing power

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and residential property exposure ahead of RBA hike and ACCC regulatory action
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate hike pressure, ACCC monopoly probe, and Trump housing policy create triple headwind for property valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim iron ore and coal exposure; rotate to defensive dividend payers
defensive_moves.rationale: Chinese growth 'sinks from sight' is a direct demand shock for BHP, FMG, BRL; banks offer yield but face credit risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD downside; consider gold as currency hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'crushed' post-Fed; RBA hike may not offset USD strength; gold offers dual hedge

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. RBA rate hike probability elevated post-Fed 4% move. Banks and miners lead declines. Oil strength provides partial offset. Consumer weakness (Cue/Veronika Maine) signals broader demand softness. Expect volatility around RBA decision and Chinese data releases.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if China stabilises. Anthropic $31bn datacentre and rare earths/gold discoveries provide structural growth pockets. However, IMF downgrade, wage stagnation, and private credit fragility cap upside. Superannuation reform debate could redirect household savings flows. Net: selective, not broad-based recovery.

RBA cash rate and statement language
ASX 200 bank index vs miners index divergence
